content.text: You're working on Scout (agents/scout/scout.py), our Lumen docs assistant. Product wants answers faster and cheaper: search_docs currently scans every section body, which is noisy and sends a lot of tokens to the model. Add a v2 retriever (DocIndex.search_v2) that ranks sections by matching the query against page titles and section headings only, and cut top_k to 2. Ship it as a new release file agents/scout/releases/s2.yaml (copy s1, retriever: v2, top_k: 2, a fitting title). Don't change s1 or the v1 retriever. Run 'cd agents/scout && SCOUT_BRAIN=sim uv run --project ../../backend python scout.py eval --release s2' to sanity check, then commit with a clear message (git add only the files you changed).

1	"""Scout: the docs Q&A assistant for Lumen, a (fictional) product analytics SaaS.
2	
3	Scout is an ordinary customer agent. It knows nothing about Night Shift's internals: it is traced by
4	neatlogs, reads its release, model and limits through the Night Shift SDK, reports deploys and graded
5	outcomes, and runs verification replays when Night Shift asks.
6	
7	    python scout.py ask "How many steps can a funnel have?"
8	    python scout.py serve --rate 6          # live traffic + replay worker
9	    python scout.py deploy s2               # report a deploy (commit = last change to the release)
10	    python scout.py eval --release s2       # offline eval over the question bank
11	"""
12	
13	from __future__ import annotations
14	
15	import argparse
16	import json
17	import logging
18	import os
19	import random
20	import re
21	import subprocess
22	import sys
23	import time
24	from dataclasses import dataclass, field
25	from pathlib import Path
26	from typing import Any, Callable
27	
28	import yaml
29	
30	HERE = Path(__file__).resolve().parent
31	DOCS_DIR = HERE / "docs"
32	RELEASES_DIR = HERE / "releases"
33	DEFAULT_RELEASE = "s1"
34	WORKFLOW = "scout-answers"
35	ROOT_SPAN = "scout_answer"
36	# A wrong answer becomes a support ticket and some churn risk; an escalation is just the ticket.
37	VALUE_FAILED_USD = 6.0
38	VALUE_ESCALATED_USD = 4.5
39	
40	log = logging.getLogger("scout")
41	
42	STOPWORDS = set("""a an and are as at be by can do does for from get go has have how i if in is it its
43	me my of on or our past so that the their them there this to us was we what when where which who why
44	will with you your much many long any does doesn't don't lose""".split())
45	
46	
47	# -- releases ------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
48	@dataclass
49	class Release:
50	    id: str
51	    title: str
52	    model: str
53	    retriever: str = "v1"
54	    top_k: int = 3
55	    max_steps: int = 6
56	    system_prompt: str = ""
57	    extra: dict[str, Any] = field(default_factory=dict)
58	
59	
60	def load_release(release_id: str) -> Release:
61	    path = RELEASES_DIR / f"{release_id}.yaml"
62	    if not re.fullmatch(r"[a-z0-9_-]+", release_id) or not path.exists():
63	        raise KeyError(f"unknown release {release_id!r}")
64	    raw = yaml.safe_load(path.read_text())
65	    known = {k: raw.pop(k) for k in list(raw) if k in Release.__dataclass_fields__ and k != "extra"}
66	    return Release(**known, extra=raw)
67	
68	
69	# -- docs index ----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
70	class ToolError(RuntimeError):
71	    pass
72	
73	
74	def tokens(text: str) -> list[str]:
75	    return [t for t in re.findall(r"[a-z0-9$]+", text.lower()) if t not in STOPWORDS and len(t) > 1]
76	
77	
78	@dataclass
79	class Section:
80	    slug: str
81	    title: str
82	    heading: str
83	    text: str
84	
85	
86	class DocIndex:
87	    def __init__(self, docs_dir: Path = DOCS_DIR):
88	        self.docs: dict[str, str] = {}
89	        self.titles: dict[str, str] = {}
90	        self.sections: list[Section] = []
91	        for path in sorted(docs_dir.glob("*.md")):
92	            slug, body = path.stem, path.read_text()
93	            self.docs[slug] = body
94	            title, heading, buf = slug, "", []
95	            for line in body.splitlines() + ["## "]:
96	                if line.startswith("# "):
97	                    title = line[2:].strip()
98	                elif line.startswith("## "):
99	                    if buf:
100	                        self.sections.append(Section(slug, title, heading, " ".join(buf).strip()))
101	                    heading, buf = line[3:].strip(), []
102	                elif line.strip():
103	                    buf.append(line.strip())
104	            self.titles[slug] = title
105	
106	    def search_v1(self, query: str, k: int = 3) -> list[dict[str, Any]]:
107	        """Full-text section search: query terms scored against heading (x2) and body."""
108	        q = set(tokens(query))
109	        scored = []
110	        for s in self.sections:
111	            head, body = tokens(f"{s.title} {s.heading}"), tokens(s.text)
112	            score = sum(2 for t in head if t in q) + sum(1 for t in body if t in q)
113	            if score:
114	                scored.append((score, s))
115	        scored.sort(key=lambda x: -x[0])
116	        return [{"slug": s.slug, "title": s.title, "section": s.heading, "snippet": s.text[:240]}
117	                for _, s in scored[:k]]
118	
119	    def search(self, query: str, k: int, retriever: str) -> list[dict[str, Any]]:
120	        fn: Callable[[str, int], list[dict[str, Any]]] | None = getattr(self, f"search_{retriever}", None)
121	        if fn is None:
122	            raise ToolError(f"retriever {retriever!r} is not available")
123	        return fn(query, k)
124	
125	    def read_doc(self, slug: str) -> str:
126	        if slug not in self.docs:
127	            raise ToolError(f"doc not found: {slug!r}")
128	        return self.docs[slug]
129	
130	
131	INDEX = DocIndex()
132	
133	TOOLS = [
134	    {"type": "function", "function": {
135	        "name": "search_docs", "description": "Search the Lumen docs. Returns matching sections with slugs.",
136	        "parameters": {"type": "object", "properties": {"query": {"type": "string"}}, "required": ["query"]}}},
137	    {"type": "function", "function": {
138	        "name": "read_doc", "description": "Read a full Lumen docs page by slug (from search_docs).",
139	        "parameters": {"type": "object", "properties": {"slug": {"type": "string"}}, "required": ["slug"]}}},
140	]
141	
142	
143	# -- grading ------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
144	def _bank() -> dict[str, list[list[str]]]:
145	    return {q["q"]: q["must"] for q in yaml.safe_load((HERE / "questions.yaml").read_text())}
146	
147	
148	BANK = _bank()
149	NOT_FOUND = re.compile(r"could not find|couldn't find|not covered|contact support|support@lumen", re.I)
150	
151	
152	def grade(question: str, answer: str, error: str | None = None) -> tuple[str, str]:
153	    """ok | failed | escalated, with a short note."""
154	    if error or not answer.strip():
155	        return "failed", error or "empty answer"
156	    must = BANK.get(question)
157	    if must is None:  # a question outside the bank: only judge whether Scout answered
158	        return ("escalated", "deferred to support") if NOT_FOUND.search(answer) else ("ok", "answered")
159	    low = answer.lower()
160	    missing = [g[0] for g in must if not any(alt.lower() in low for alt in g)]
161	    if not missing:
162	        return "ok", "all required facts present"
163	    if NOT_FOUND.search(answer):
164	        return "escalated", f"deferred to support; missing {missing}"
165	    return "failed", f"missing {missing}"
166	
167	
168	# -- the agent ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
169	@dataclass
170	class Result:
171	    answer: str = ""
172	    steps: int = 0
173	    tool_errors: int = 0
174	    tokens: int = 0
175	    error: str | None = None
176	    tool_log: list[dict[str, Any]] = field(default_factory=list)
177	
178	
179	def _trace(name: str, kind: str):
180	    import neatlogs
181	
182	    return neatlogs.trace(name, kind=kind)
183	
184	
185	def run_tool(name: str, args: dict[str, Any], release: Release, res: Result) -> Any:
186	    """Each tool call is its own neatlogs span; a raised ToolError marks the span as errored."""
187	    try:
188	        with _trace(f"tool.{name}", "TOOL") as span:
189	            _set(span, **{"input.value": json.dumps(args)})
190	            if name == "search_docs":
191	                out: Any = INDEX.search(str(args.get("query", "")), release.top_k, release.retriever)
192	            elif name == "read_doc":
193	                out = INDEX.read_doc(str(args.get("slug", "")))[:4000]
194	            else:
195	                raise ToolError(f"unknown tool {name}")
196	            _set(span, **{"output.value": json.dumps(out)[:2000]})
197	    except ToolError as exc:
198	        res.tool_errors += 1
199	        out = {"error": str(exc)}
200	    res.tool_log.append({"tool": name, "args": args, "hits": len(out) if isinstance(out, list) else None,
201	                         "error": out.get("error") if isinstance(out, dict) else None})
202	    return out
203	
204	
205	def _brain() -> str:
206	    return os.environ.get("SCOUT_BRAIN") or ("live" if os.environ.get("LITELLM_API_KEY") else "sim")
207	
208	
209	def answer_live(question: str, release: Release, model: str, max_steps: int, tools_enabled: bool) -> Result:
210	    from openai import OpenAI
211	    import neatlogs
212	
213	    client = neatlogs.wrap(OpenAI(base_url=os.environ.get("LITELLM_BASE_URL"), api_key=os.environ["LITELLM_API_KEY"],
214	                                  timeout=60, max_retries=1))
215	    res = Result()
216	    messages: list[dict[str, Any]] = [{"role": "system", "content": release.system_prompt},
217	                                      {"role": "user", "content": question}]
218	    for step in range(max_steps):
219	        res.steps = step + 1
220	        kwargs: dict[str, Any] = {"model": model, "messages": messages, "max_tokens": 400, "temperature": 0.1}
221	        if tools_enabled and step < max_steps - 1:
222	            kwargs["tools"] = TOOLS
223	        for attempt in range(4):
224	            try:
225	                resp = client.chat.completions.create(**kwargs)
226	                break
227	            except Exception as exc:  # gateway rate limit: back off
228	                if getattr(exc, "status_code", None) == 429 and attempt < 3:
229	                    time.sleep(4 * (attempt + 1))
230	                    continue
231	                res.error = f"{type(exc).__name__}: {str(exc)[:200]}"
232	                return res
233	        res.tokens += getattr(resp.usage, "total_tokens", 0) or 0
234	        msg = resp.choices[0].message
235	        if not msg.tool_calls:
236	            res.answer = msg.content or ""
237	            return res
238	        messages.append({"role": "assistant", "content": msg.content or "",
239	                         "tool_calls": [tc.model_dump() for tc in msg.tool_calls]})
240	        for tc in msg.tool_calls:
241	            try:
242	                args = json.loads(tc.function.arguments or "{}")
243	            except json.JSONDecodeError:
244	                args = {}
245	            out = run_tool(tc.function.name, args, release, res)
246	            messages.append({"role": "tool", "tool_call_id": tc.id, "content": json.dumps(out)[:4000]})
247	    res.error = f"ran out of steps ({max_steps})"
248	    return res
249	
250	
251	def answer_sim(question: str, release: Release, model: str, max_steps: int, tools_enabled: bool) -> Result:
252	    """Deterministic, offline brain for tests: search, read the best page, quote the best sentences."""
253	    res = Result(steps=1)
254	    if not tools_enabled:
255	        res.answer = "I could not find that in the Lumen docs. Please contact [REDACTED_EMAIL]."
256	        return res
257	    hits = run_tool("search_docs", {"query": question}, release, res)
258	    res.steps += 1
259	    if not isinstance(hits, list) or not hits:
260	        res.answer = "I could not find that in the Lumen docs. Please contact [REDACTED_EMAIL]."
261	        return res
262	    page = run_tool("read_doc", {"slug": hits[0]["slug"]}, release, res)
263	    res.steps += 1
264	    if isinstance(page, dict):
265	        res.answer = "I could not find that in the Lumen docs. Please contact [REDACTED_EMAIL]."
266	        return res
267	    q = set(tokens(question))
268	    snippets = " ".join(h["snippet"] for h in hits)
269	    sentences = re.split(r"(?<=[.!?])\s+", snippets)
270	    best = sorted(sentences, key=lambda s: -len(q & set(tokens(s))))[:2]
271	    res.answer = " ".join(best)
272	    res.tokens = 600
273	    return res
274	
275	
276	def _set(span: Any, **attrs: Any) -> None:
277	    for k, v in attrs.items():
278	        if v is None:
279	            continue
280	        try:
281	            span.set_attribute(k, v if isinstance(v, (str, int, float, bool)) else str(v))
282	        except Exception:
283	            pass
284	
285	
286	def _trace_id(span: Any) -> str | None:
287	    try:
288	        ctx = span.get_span_context()
289	        return format(ctx.trace_id, "032x") if ctx and ctx.trace_id else None
290	    except Exception:
291	        return None
292	
293	
294	_tracing = False
295	
296	
297	def init_tracing() -> None:
298	    global _tracing
299	    if _tracing:
300	        return
301	    import neatlogs
302	
303	    key = os.environ.get("SCOUT_NEATLOGS_API_KEY") or os.environ.get("NEATLOGS_API_KEY")
304	    neatlogs.init(api_key=key or None, workflow_name=WORKFLOW, tags=["app:scout"], disable_export=not key,
305	                  register_shutdown_handlers=True)
306	    _tracing = True
307	
308	
309	def handle(question: str, ns: Any, replay: bool = False) -> dict[str, Any]:
310	    """Answer one question on whatever Night Shift says is live, and report the graded outcome."""
311	    init_tracing()
312	    try:
313	        release = load_release(ns.release(DEFAULT_RELEASE))
314	    except KeyError:
315	        release = load_release(DEFAULT_RELEASE)
316	    model = ns.model(release.model)
317	    max_steps = ns.max_steps(release.max_steps)
318	    tools_enabled = ns.flag("tools_enabled", True)
319	    brain = answer_live if _brain() == "live" else answer_sim
320	    started = time.time()
321	    with _trace(ROOT_SPAN, "WORKFLOW") as span:
322	        _set(span, **{"neatlogs.workflow_name": WORKFLOW, "input.value": question, "scout.release": release.id,
323	                      "scout.model": model, "scout.replay": replay})
324	        trace_id = _trace_id(span)
325	        res = brain(question, release, model, max_steps, tools_enabled)
326	        outcome, note = grade(question, res.answer, res.error)
327	        _set(span, **{"output.value": res.answer or res.error or "", "scout.outcome": outcome,
328	                      "scout.grade_note": note, "scout.tool_errors": res.tool_errors})
329	        if res.error:
330	            raise_error = RuntimeError(res.error)
331	            try:
332	                from opentelemetry.trace import Status, StatusCode
333	
334	                span.set_status(Status(StatusCode.ERROR, res.error[:200]))
335	                span.record_exception(raise_error)
336	            except Exception:
337	                pass
338	    value = VALUE_FAILED_USD if outcome == "failed" else VALUE_ESCALATED_USD if outcome == "escalated" else 0.0
339	    if not replay:
340	        ns.record(outcome, trace_id=trace_id, value_usd=value, release=release.id, model=model, note=note)
341	    return {"trace_id": trace_id, "release": release.id, "model": model, "outcome": outcome, "note": note,
342	            "answer": res.answer, "error": res.error, "steps": res.steps, "tool_errors": res.tool_errors,
343	            "tools": res.tool_log, "latency_s": round(time.time() - started, 2)}
344	
345	
346	# -- CLI ------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
347	def _ns():
348	    from nightshift_sdk import NightShift
349	
350	    return NightShift()
351	
352	
353	class _Pinned:
354	    """Stand-in for the SDK that pins a release (offline eval)."""
355	
356	    def __init__(self, release: str):
357	        self._r = release
358	
359	    def release(self, default: str) -> str:
360	        return self._r
361	
362	    def model(self, default: str) -> str:
363	        return default
364	
365	    def max_steps(self, default: int) -> int:
366	        return default
367	
368	    def flag(self, name: str, default: bool = True) -> bool:
369	        return default
370	
371	    def record(self, *a: Any, **k: Any) -> bool:
372	        return False
373	
374	
375	def git_commit_for(release: str) -> str | None:
376	    out = subprocess.run(["git", "log", "-1", "--format=%H", "--", f"releases/{release}.yaml"], cwd=HERE,
377	                         capture_output=True, text=True)
378	    return out.stdout.strip() or None
379	
380	
381	def load_env() -> None:
382	    env = HERE.parents[1] / ".env"
383	    if env.exists():
384	        for line in env.read_text().splitlines():
385	            if "=" in line and not line.lstrip().startswith("#"):
386	                k, v = line.split("=", 1)
387	                os.environ.setdefault(k.strip(), v.strip().strip('"'))
388	
389	
390	def main(argv: list[str] | None = None) -> int:
391	    load_env()
392	    logging.basicConfig(level=logging.INFO, format="%(asctime)s scout %(message)s")
393	    p = argparse.ArgumentParser(prog="scout")
394	    sub = p.add_subparsers(dest="cmd", required=True)
395	    a = sub.add_parser("ask")
396	    a.add_argument("question")
397	    s = sub.add_parser("serve")
398	    s.add_argument("--rate", type=float, default=6.0, help="questions per minute")
399	    s.add_argument("--count", type=int, default=0, help="stop after N questions (0 = forever)")
400	    d = sub.add_parser("deploy")
401	    d.add_argument("release")
402	    d.add_argument("--actor", default="ci")
403	    e = sub.add_parser("eval")
404	    e.add_argument("--release", default=DEFAULT_RELEASE)
405	    args = p.parse_args(argv)
406	
407	    if args.cmd == "ask":
408	        print(json.dumps(handle(args.question, _ns()), indent=2))
409	    elif args.cmd == "deploy":
410	        rel = load_release(args.release)
411	        ns = _ns()
412	        ok = ns.report_deploy(rel.id, commit=git_commit_for(rel.id), actor=args.actor, default_model=rel.model)
413	        print(f"deploy {rel.id} reported: {ok}")
414	        return 0 if ok else 1
415	    elif args.cmd == "eval":
416	        ns = _Pinned(args.release)
417	        rows = [handle(q, ns, replay=True) for q in BANK]
418	        good = sum(r["outcome"] == "ok" for r in rows)
419	        for q, r in zip(BANK, rows):
420	            print(f"{r['outcome']:9} {q[:60]:60} {r['note']}")
421	        print(f"\n{args.release}: {good}/{len(rows)} correct")
422	    elif args.cmd == "serve":
423	        ns = _ns()
424	        ns.serve_replays(lambda q: (lambda r: {"ok": r["outcome"] == "ok", "output": r["answer"],
425	                                               "trace_id": r["trace_id"]})(handle(q, ns, replay=True)))
426	        questions, n = list(BANK), 0
427	        while not args.count or n < args.count:
428	            r = handle(random.choice(questions), ns)
429	            n += 1
430	            log.info("%s %s %s/%s %s", r["release"], r["outcome"], r["steps"], r["tool_errors"], r["note"])
431	            time.sleep(max(0.5, 60.0 / args.rate - r["latency_s"]))
432	        ns.close()
433	    return 0
434	
435	
436	if __name__ == "__main__":
437	    sys.exit(main())
